alsoGreen.intent: Structured Text instead of Instruction List: the same condition as one assignment

files.src/DoorAlarm.st:
PROGRAM DoorAlarm
VAR_INPUT Armed AT %I0.0 : BOOL; DoorOpen AT %I0.1 : BOOL; Silence AT %I0.2 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Siren AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; END_VAR
Siren := ((Armed AND DoorOpen) OR Siren) AND NOT Silence;
END_PROGRAM

wrong.intent: holds nothing: the siren follows the door

files.src/DoorAlarm.il:
PROGRAM DoorAlarm
VAR_INPUT
    Armed AT %I0.0 : BOOL;
    DoorOpen AT %I0.1 : BOOL;
    Silence AT %I0.2 : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Siren AT %Q0.0 : BOOL;
END_VAR

        LD    Armed
        AND   DoorOpen
        ANDN  Silence
        ST    Siren
END_PROGRAM

wrong.intent: never reads Silence, so the siren cannot be turned off
